verdict.rationale: CSC is a SaaS entity-management and registered-agent service that advertises APIs, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only says APIs and integrations exist; it never mentions a public, explorable API reference or runnable examples. Probes for common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
